_readme: Transfers the official J.LEAGUE page (jleague.jp/{j1,j2,j3}/special/transfer/) has not published.
That page is not exhaustive: 加入内定 / 特別指定選手 announcements in particular appear only sometimes
(浦和 announced 稲垣篤志 and 田中玲音 together on 2026-08-06; only 稲垣 was listed).
An official row for the same clubKey + player + direction always wins, so a stale entry cannot
duplicate a row — but delete it once the official source carries the move.
Required: league, clubKey, club, direction, date, player, otherClub.
Optional: roman, pos, age, transferType, playerId, marketValueNum, nationality, nationalityFlag.
Manual rows skip Transfermarkt enrichment, so whatever is written here is what the site shows.

transfers.source: https://www.vissel-kobe.co.jp/news/article/26777.html — 2029/30シーズン加入内定 + 2026/27 JFA・Jリーグ特別指定選手承認
